tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub dkyil dang po'i blo can rab gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi rastu/ bstan la rab gus dbang brten bcas/ /thos dang mthar phyin sngags pa yis/ /sa chog tshul bzhin byas pa'i sar/ /thig chen brgyad dam dkyil 'khor gyi/ /skya thig rdzogs par btab pa'i dbus/ /dri yi thig le gru bzhi dang / /phyogs mtshams rnams su zlum po'i steng / /me tog tshom bu re rer bgod/ /de'i dbus su mañdzi la/ /sogs pa'i steng du sa lha yi/ /maṇ+ḍal tshom bu legs par bshams/ /ras bris ltar na lha dgu yi/ /tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal la bkod de/ /sa lha 'og dang lha dgu yi/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du bshams na mdzes/ /de yi phyi rol byang shar gyi/ /mtshams su mtshams 'dzin me tog dang / /chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams/ /shar nas brtsams te gru bzhir bshams/ /shar nub gnyis su lhag re dang / /bcas pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ru/ /bdug spos mar me zhal zas re/ /g.yas skor dag tu gru bzhir bshams/ /sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal nye logs su/ /gtor ma gcig bshams 'byor gyur na/ /sgos mchod kyang bshams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /byang shar nas brtsams shar lho'i bar/ /'das pa'i lha dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /gtor ma gnyis sam lnga la sogs/ /gang dgos bshams shing logs shig tu/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma'ang bshams/ /slob dpon mdun du rdor dril dang / /nang mchod sogs bshams bum pa gnyis/ /legs bkrus kha tshar ma nyams pa'i/ /ras bzang mgul 'ching srog lnga pa'am/ /bdun pa legs bcings mtshan ma gdar/ /drag sngags bzla zhing gu gul gyis/ /legs bdug yungs kar dag gis brab/ /gtsang ma'i chu yis sum gnyis dgang / /'bru sna sman lnga rin chen lnga/ /snying po lnga dang dri bzang lnga/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas gzhug /ku shas kha brgyan rnam rgyal steng / /dung chos dri bzang chur bcas dang / /rdo rje gzungs thag sogs kun bshams/

/sngon 'gro gtor mar chab kyis sbran/ /rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shūd+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shūd+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams rim pas bstan te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa du ma spros pas phyogs skyong ba rnams bkug par bsam la g.yas pa'i mdzub mo phyogs bcur bskor ba lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ in+d+ra duṣ+ṭaṃ sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ phyogs skyong rnams mdun du 'khod pa la spyi bo nas phur bus btab pas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam la/ de la phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥya ma ya ṣ+ṭiḥwa ru ṇa ya wi ku bai rā ya kṛ/ i shwa rā ya ta ag+na ye ā nairti ta ye na wa ya we na/ brah+ma ṇa ya hūm̐/ pṛ thi wi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ha ha ha hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/ a lo kā+e gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bcu yi tshogs la 'dud/ /ces pa'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun chags kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bsgrub cing mchod pa dang /

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung zhing dngos grub bsgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ dril bsil bzhag rdo rje'i rtse sa la reg pa'i tshul dang / su gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol la gtor ma phyir dor/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs dang / oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs dang / oṃ ya man+ta ka sogs brjod/ gnas yor rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nas/ 'dir rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun chags rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang mdzad/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyis byin rlabs/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ ngag tu bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das༞ dam pa'i chos༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun༞ zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus kyi mthar rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par bsam/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi bab ste yab kyi sku gang / de nas dbyibs brgyud yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ bdag gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang / rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la ngag tu/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs nas/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ bar ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag bsgrub mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa ltar gyur/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lnga 'phros pas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes pas bla ma dang / na maḥshrī badz+ra bhai ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥ zhes pas yi dam la phyag byas par bsams la/ snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' gong bzhin sbyar la/ mā l+ya traṃ/ gīrti hrīḥ nīrti āḥ dhū pe hūm̐/ puṣ+pe trāṃ/ dī pe hrīḥ gan+dhe āḥ zhes dang / mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ zhes brjod la thal mo sbyar te/ dkon chog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/

/rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas bsgrub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing /

/sems can mya ngan 'das la bgod/ /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgoms/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun tu 'od zer 'phros pas sra zhing brtan pa mi phyed cing rgya che ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re/ phyi rol kun tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bas yongs su bskor bas bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba 'bar bas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i sa gzhi la khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du mi mgo skam po'i rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig dang ldan pa steng keng rus kyis phub pa g.yang gzhi bla re dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang / rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang sprin dang me dang chu dang / mchod rten dang / klu dang bcas shing grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang ro langs dang / sha za dang 'byung po'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bskor ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi shes pa dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can/

de las tshad med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas nas/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'jam dbyangs su gyur pa ni gser btso ma'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / g.yas pa'i phyag gis rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri/ g.yon pa'i phyag gis ut+pa lar gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan cing / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis na bzas bklubs shing 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phro ba/ zhi ba dang 'dzum pa dang / sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i thugs kar ā yig ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med par spyan drangs bdag la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣi ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang rang gi sgra 'brug gi dbyangs bzhin sgrog bzhin pa dpag tu med pa bkug la thim pas hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing nag chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje dang gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan dpag tu med par bkug la thim pas/

rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa shin tu gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ hūm̐ de las yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs su byas nas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu 'dus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs rje'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /khro bor gyur pa gshin rje gshed/ /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyangs rnam par 'gyings nas bzhugs/ /rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra chen sgrog /steng zhal dmar po rgya cher bzhad/ /de steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal/ /gser gyi mdog can cung zad khros/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs kyi zhal/ /dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs/ /gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril zhing / /gsum pa ser po khro gnyer can/ /g.yon pa'i rwa yi phyogs su zhal/ /dang po dkar pos rmongs par byed/ /gnyis pa dud khas rengs par byed/ /gsum pa nag pos gsod par byed/ /zhal rnams thams cad spyan gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing dang / /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /dgra satwa mdung mda' lcags kyu dang / /dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba dang / /ral gri rnge'u chung rim bzhin 'dzin/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /mgo phub rkang pa zhags pa gzhu/ /rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang / /ro ras skyes bu gsal shing phug /me thab thod tshal sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras 'dzin/ /tha ma yi ni phyag gnyis kyis/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyi rim bzhin du/

/mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mong khyi lug ce spyang mnan/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang / /'ug pa khra dang bya rog dang / /ne tso khyung chen ri skegs bzhed/ /mnan cing zhabs rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang dang / /drag po gzhon nu gdong drug rnams/ /bsgyel nas kha phub nyid du mnan/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lnga yis/ /khro zhal rnams kyis dbu la brgyan/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu dang / /sbrul nag chun pos do shal byas/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po glog ltar khyug /rus rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang / /khrag zhag dmar po'i thig le dang / /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /liṅga dmar po gyen du langs/ /sku las sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro/ /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shugs 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ /mig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lce 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra l+ya se hūm̐/ sgeg sogs brgyad phyag rgyar bcas pas mchod la thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/

/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra u bhi ka a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ta satwaṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ thams cad kyi khro bo'i phyag mtshan dang chas rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang / dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ khyad par du khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad la dbang bskur ba byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying kha nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu rnams spros pas dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas par bsam zhing / phyag rgya rnams kyai rdor bzhin bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ de bzhin du oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan+ḍe hoḥzhes brjod/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can gyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam la/ thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag phan tshun bsnol mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas cung zad ma reg pa bkug pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dpral mgrin snying kha gsum du yas mar reg cing hrīḥṣ+ṭī lan re brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas blangs nas 'di nyid la gtor te/ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung dang raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/

shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su ya/ shar du k+ṣe/ lhor ma/ nub tu me/ byang du da/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge lnga dang bcas pa zhu nas spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas/ byang du don yod grub pa rnams so so'i yum dang bcas pa de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ rigs lnga'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ de nyid kyi tshe bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum bcu 'od du zhu nas 'dres pas kha dog dang / dri dang ro dang bcud phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab ste myang pas lus thams cad bde bas khyab par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam zhing / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la mtshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ /gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya sgeg pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol par mdzod/

/hoḥ chags pa med bzhin chags pa mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la lha mo de rnams kyis bstod par bsam zhing / dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la bstod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phreng ba la rdo rje'i nang mchod gtor te/ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du phreng rdog re re nas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa gri thod 'dzin pa'i skur gyur par bsam la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭī ci rigs bzlas te phreng ba la has btab pa bzung ste/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang 'jigs byed du bsgom pa'i snying khar rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa gur thabs/ de'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ de gnyis kyi lte ba sprad cing / pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad po rtsibs kyi nang du song ba/ lte bar hūm̐ sngon po'i mtha'i nye snying dang / de'i mthar snying po gnyis g.yas bskor/ 'dab ma'i steng gi bar snang la/ shar du ya ma rā dza/ mer sa do me ya/ lhor ya me do ru/ srin por ṇa yo da ya/ nub tu ya da yo ni/ rlung du ra ya k+ṣi ya/ byang du yak+ṣi yats+tsha/ dbang ldan du ni ra ma ya rnams langs stabs su yod pa'i steng du oṃ dang 'og tu hūm̐ phaṭa rnams kha dog sngon po/

de rnams las las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas 'phrin las bzhi bsgrub cing / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam la/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang / oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang / oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nye snying rnams ci nus bzla/ bzlas pa'i rjes su phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod la phreng ba la has btab pa mgo thog tu bzhag rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsam/ phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis mchod rdzas rnams byin brlabs/ sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal/ ya man+tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas dpang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas oṃ badz+ras sbyangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ oṃ pṛ thi wī oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ gan+dhe ra ṇi ta rol chen dang bcas pa'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang bcas pas oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā lan gsum gyis bsngos/ rdor dril spos mdangs dang bcas pas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyobs pa shākya seṅge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas nas dkyil 'khor bris/ /rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu rgyun chags kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nas 'tshal na bar sngon gtor bzhin la sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ oṃ pṛ thi de wi oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ pṛ thi de wi oṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ phyag rgya se gol bcas/ oṃ pṛ thi de wi badz+ra muḥ zhes lag g.yas sa la reg pas/ sa de nyid la thim par bsam la sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal dang gtor ma la sogs pa gsol/ de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bgod sngags/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi wiṣ+ṭi tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar dgus tshom bu bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par zhes sogs nas/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon sra zhing brtan pa'i sa gzhi zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gsal btab la/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du gyur/ slar yang 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/

phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dang / steng du langs pa'i pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje'i nor bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / lnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang bas bskor bas nang gi lha snam shar dkar lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang ba sgo tshad gcig dang ldan pa dbus sngo ba'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng ba zlum por bskor ba'i nang re'u mig dgu dang ldan pa'i dbus su ro mgo med lag med dang / phyogs mtshams kyi re'u mig rnams dang / lha rnams kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad/ phyag mtshan rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re dang bcas pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ bdag mdun mi 'dra ba'i tshig khyad par rnams gong gi bum bskyed bzhin bya/

khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ro langs chen po brgyad dang bcas par gyur pa ni/ dbus su/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes sogs nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bor bskyed/ de'i shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa/ lha snam la shar sgo'i g.yas nas gri gug 'phang / mdung / gtun shing / g.yon pas chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa lcags kyu/ lho sgo'i g.yas nas dgra satwa/ mda'/ dbyig pa/ g.yon nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ nub sgo'i g.yas nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rnge'u chung / phub/ g.yon nas gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang sgo'i g.yas nas sdigs mdzub/ phan rtse gsum/ glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yon nas tho ba/ mdung / me thabs rnams dang / sgo mtshams brgyad du bhaiṃ gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i ro langs chen po brgyad mdog nag po lce brkyang nas ha ha zhes drag tu rgod pa la gdengs shing / dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa dang / lha snam gyi grwa rnams su bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa brgyad dang ldan par bskyed/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ nas/ kun tu bzang po'i bar/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra la s+ye hūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas/ yar lud pa las bar gong bzhin/ lha dgu char la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥnas ho bar gong bzhin gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas lan re brjod par sems pa gsum brtsegs gong bzhin/

de nas mar me la sogs pa sbar/ oṃ ya man+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la nas rol mo byin rlabs kyi bar gnas yo bzhin/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi mi dgos/ pang par khu tshur steng 'og tu brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya dang gdangs bcas/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /zhes pa'i mthar pad skor sngon 'gro'i mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya se gol bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil༞ pā d+yaṃ༞ me tog 'di ni༞ oṃ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyi rigs 'gre sbyar la/ shap+ta'i mthar gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa dang / gos zung bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ gos zung khu tshur gnyis kyis mtho bar bzung la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba sogs mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ sa pā ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye āḥhūm̐/ thog mar g.yas mtho bar bteg pas stod g.yogs de nas g.yon dma' bar bzung bas smad g.yogs 'bul tshul phal cher las 'byung / kyai rdor dkyil chog sogs na de las bzlog pa'ang gsung yod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi la g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs/ dbus nas len tshul byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes spyi bo'i thad nas gtor/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la lī ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ rwa rdo rje grags/ ra chos rab/ rwa ye shes seṅge/ rwa 'bum seng ge klog skya dbang phyug grags/ sdong ston shes rab dpal/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang po/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ṭi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa thar rtse ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' bsam grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes smin mtshams nas/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad/ man ngag nos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs ka nas gtor/ oṃ ya ma ra dza hrīḥṣ+ṭi༞ oṃ ya man+ta ka༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ༞ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du༞ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod de myangs pas lus dkyil gyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/ gtor ma la bar phud bran la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā li de wi dharma pā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra/

rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du༞ oṃ kā la ru pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du༞ zhes lte ba'i thad nas gtor/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan bsrung dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du༞ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi༞ gzhan yang / gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du༞ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du༞ 'thur du gtor la/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du༞ tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra sogs brjod cing rang gis kyang myang oṃ 'dir gsor thogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pa/ /oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra nīrti āḥ zhes dku g.yon pa khu tshur gnyis kha sbyar dkrol nas gar skor dang / lā se ma'i phyag rgya khu tshur dku g.yas g.yon du bzhag pa/ mā le smin mtshams thad nas khu tshur gnyis phyir bstan/ gī tī mar/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin tshul/ nīrti mar sor mo bsnol ba'i thal mo spyi bor bskor/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa su saṃ gra hata/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra rat+na ma nu traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra dharmā gā ya ni/ oṃ badz+ra a lo kā+e hrīḥ badz+ra karma ka rota bha wa/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ rnams la dkur khu tshur kha sbyar gar skor spos sogs bzhi'i phyag rgya byas/ rdor dril rol chen bcas/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /zhes sogs dang / hūm̐/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun 'jigs khyod la bstod/ /mi'u thung sgeg sprin lta bu'i mdog /'od zer 'phro ba rnam par bzhengs/ /mtshan ma legs po ma he'i zhal/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni ma he khros/ /bar pa srin po khros dmar zhal/ /steng ma gser mdog 'jam dbyangs zhal/ /sngon po dmar po ser po la/ /dkar po dud kha nag po ste/ /zhal dgu ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas kyi dang po gri gug 'dzin/ /gnyis pas mtshon rtse gcig pa 'dzin/ /gsum pa'i phyag gis gtun shing 'dzin/ /bzhi pas chu gri bzang po 'dzin/ /lnga pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ /drug pa na ni satwa re ste/ /bdun pa'i phyag gis mdung chung 'dzin/ /brgyad pa yis ni mda' 'dzin cing / /dgu pa'i phyag gis lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcu pa'i phyag gis dbyug tho 'dzin/ /bcu gcig pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bcu gnyis pa yis 'khor lo 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yis rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcu bzhi rdo rje tho ba 'dzin/ /bco lnga dgra gsod ral gri 'dzin/ /bcu drug pa na cang te'u 'dzin/ /de ltar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag 'dzin/ /gnyis pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin/ /gsum pas shes rab phub chung 'dzin/ /bzhi pas bsgrub bya'i rkang pa 'dzin/ /lnga pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin/ /drug pas zhu 'dzin thabs kyi don/

/bdun pas nyon mongs rgyu ma 'dzin/ /brgyad pas shes rab dril bu 'dzin/ /dgu pas bdag don lag pa 'dzin/ /bcu pas 'bri don dur khrod ras/ /skyes bu gsal shing bcu gcig pa/ /bcu gnyis bsreg don me thabs 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yis thod tshal 'dzin/ /bcu bzhis sdigs mdzub sdigs par mdzad/ /bco lngas 'phan rtse dug gsum 'joms/ /bsgrub bya rlung bskur bcu drug ras/ /tha ma'i phyag gnyis glang chen gyis/ /ko rlon brgyangs pa na bza' gsol/ /yon tan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin du/ /mi dang ma he glang bong bu/ /rnga mo khyi lug lce spyang bsnams/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i steng nas gnon/ /nad brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon rnams rim bzhin bya rgod dang / /'ug pa khra dang bya rog dang / /ne tso khyung chen ri skegs gzhed/ /khyab 'jug drag po'i steng nas gnon/ /gdon brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /gzhal yas me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgya phyed mgo bos do shal byas/ /dbu la thod skam lnga lngas brgyan/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal dgu ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan mig nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar/ /ljags 'dril zhal ni ha ha bzhad/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang de'i phyogs mtshams re'u mig tu/ /mgo lag rgyu ma rkang pa dang / /thod pa thod tshal ro ras dang / /skyes bu gsal shing phug pa'i ro/ /rnam par gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar sgo'i nang g.yas gri gug dang / /'phang mdung gtun shing g.yon pa na/ /chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig dang / /lcags kyu gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho sgo'i nang g.yas dgra satwa dang / /mda' dbyig g.yon nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'khor lo rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ /rnam par gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub sgo'i nang g.yas rdor rtse lnga/

/rnge'u chung phub dang g.yon pa nas/ /gzhu dang dril bu rlung ras rnams/ /rnam par gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang sgo'i nang g.yas sdigs mdzub dang / /'phan rtse gsum pa glang chen lpags/ /g.yon nas tho ba mdung me thabs/ /rnam par gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo bzhi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi char/ /bhaiṃ yig las byung ro langs brgyad/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis gdengs/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs la phyag 'tshal/ /grwa bzhir rin chen bum bcud can/ /gnyis gnyis gnas pas legs spras shing / /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs can/ /mtshan rdzogs gzhal yas la phyag 'tshal/ /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad gnas su/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu sogs dang / /kun nas sra brtan brjid pa yi/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan dus dgra'i rten brten par/ /dpal ldan rdo rje grags bstod kyis/ /dpal ldan rjes 'brangs phul ba'i dge /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed 'grub shog /'di'i zhabs bstod yan dang 'og gi dur khrod chen po nas/ ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar rwa chen gyis gsungs/ zhabs bstod 'phags pa rin po che'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma dang bstun zhing / rgyan bkod ro langs pho brang dur khrod srung 'khor bstod pa 'dod gsol rnams kho bos yin no/ /nang mchod ltar bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pa'i byin rlabs rgyas par byas la 'khor dang bcas pas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs dang / ya man+ta ka sogs sngags gsum ka rdzogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags de'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul/ sh+lau ka re re'i mtshams su rdor dril gsor dkrol dang /

gzugs sgra la sogs kyis yid mchod dang / dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs kyis bstod pa/ dril bu chig rdung gis/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi mthar thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ nag po chen po sogs la 'bul na skabs 'dir 'bul/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma la lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams rim par bstan te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang yang brjod pas byin brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa du ma spros pas phyogs skyong ba rnams bkug par bsam la/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo phyogs bcur skor ba lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭi dang in+d+ra duṣ+ṭaṃ sa pā ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ phyogs skyong rnams mdun du 'khod pa la spyi bo nas phur bus btab pas skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam la phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥzhes sogs nas shog bar sngon gtor bzhin/ las gshin gyi gtor ma gong ltar byin brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las las kyi gshin rje mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing / gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim la/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par bsams la/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba dbyug pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ ka la ru pa sa ma ya satwaṃ/ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ ka la ru pa gṛh+ṇe d+yaṃ zhes kun la sbyar/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas/ nai wi d+yaṃ swāhā/ bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ka la rū pa sarba bhigh+nan shā truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ bha ling kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lnga la sogs pas phul/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsum brdungs/ hūm̐/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /srog la rngams pa'i gshin rje ni/ /nag po ma he'i gdan steng du/ /ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni/ /thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba'i/ /gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdongs/ /za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrug /skra ser smra ra gyen du 'dzings/ /lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'chings/ /lag g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje tshogs/ /bran dang bcas pa'i dus la babs/ /rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu chig brdungs/ sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod pa bzhes/ /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang / /snying rje dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ /khug cig drongs shig dbang du bsdus/ /gsod cig sprod cig rengs par gyis/ /phyes shig bsnun cig rmugs par gyis/

/thul cig choms shig rnam par bshig /rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis/ /zhes brjod bzlas pa byed na yi dam gyi sngags kyi 'go drangs la/ oṃ kā la ru pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / oṃ kā la ru pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pas ji ltar bsgo ba khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs phul la spos rdor 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /rig sngags rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi lha tshogs dang / /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' bas/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs nas/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyi yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i steng du dhīḥyig nyi ma'i mdog can sogs dang / slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpa'i dbyangs su gyur pa ni sogs dang / dpag tu med par spyan drangs/ de la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las sogs/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes sogs gong bzhin la/ phug pa/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ de'i phyi rol tu shar gyi g.yas nas gri gug zhes sogs dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du bhaiṃ gyi zhes sogs nas/

brgyan pa dang bar gong bzhin/ de dang dus mnyam du las thams cad pa'i bum par gtso bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing / dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par bskyed/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas/ 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor/ bar gong bzhin la/ las bum gyi lha dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha bcu char la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du oṃ badz+ra aṅku sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā gu ru badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ rol chen/ mtheb srin gyi nang mchod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ gzugs sgra sogs yid mchod/ slar dur khrod rgyan gyi sogs tshig rkang drug gis bstod/ pad skor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song ba lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam zhing gzungs thag nas bzung ste rnam rgyal la hrīḥṣ+ṭi dang / las bum la ya man+ta ka brgya rtsa re bzlas la/ slar yang phyi nang yid byung gi bstod pa rnams byas nas/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ gtor ma rnams sngar ma phul na 'dir phul/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la phyi nang yid byung gi bstod pa rnams bum bskyed bzhin/ yig brgya lan gsum/

ma 'byor ba dang sh+lau ka gcig gang yang bdag cag sogs nas/ lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ bar spyi 'gre bzhin/ gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas nam mkhar bteg par bsam ste/ oṃ badz+rota tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te ji srid sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod la slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod/ gtor mgron gyi bris sku sogs yod na brten bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyi se gol dang / badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nasaḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ yid kun tu bzang po sogs bar gong bzhin gnas gsum dang skye mched drug bsrung la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'grub gyur nas sogs dang / khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /de las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bcom nas/ /bde ba che la rol bar shog /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /sogs nas bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces bsngo smon dang zhwa gyon/ rdor dril bcas 'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis sogs byas la/ de nas rdul tshon ltar na thig tshon rnams mdun du phyogs mdog gis bkod pa ltar bzhag tshon la rdo rje'i rtses/

yak+ṣe ma me da bris/ mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bshams la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣas mtshan pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ser po ma las rin chen mas mtshan pa las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+mas mtshan pas gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang khu da las ral gri das mtshan pa las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi mig 'bras las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkha'i lha las ye shes kyi thig tshon spyan drangs shing thim par bsam zhing mig gi rdzi ma brdab pa dang bcas te/ oṃ dip+ta ḍib ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod la so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs pa'i gtor ma a ka ros phul/ mtheb mdzub kyis mnye zhing oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod lha rnams zhu bas thig tshon du bsam/ rim pas brkyangs te/ oṃ a n+yo3n+ya a nu ga hāḥsarba dharmā s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra añdza mi/ a d+yan+te a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharma badz+ra bhan+dha/ zhes brjod cing bsgril/ rdo rje la dkris la nang mchod gtor/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du phyogs la dz+dzaḥgasum brjod de thig skud gtad/

slob ma gti mug ya ma'i nga rgyal gyis shar nas nub tu phyogs pas dz+dzaḥgasum brjod cing blangs te gnyis ka'i lte ba'i thad bzung la/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol 'debs/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /oṃ badz+ra su pra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dang por nam mkha' dang / de nas sa la phab te tshangs thig dang po dang / de nas g.yas skor gyis slob dpon byang dang slob ma lhor gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ slob dpon me dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon srin po dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa bteg te dkyil 'khor du lam gyis grub par bsam/ oṃ badz+rota tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pas sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor gyi 'og nas bzhugs par bsam ste/ khro bo'i blta bas phyogs bzhir blta zhing / oṃ badz+rota gha ṭa ya/ sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi dbye bar bsam la sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dbye'o/ /de nas rang dbus su 'dug ste/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /gshin rje gshed po rgyal chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oṃ sa ma ya tsi kra mā ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing g.yon pas khu tshur gyis dbang ldan nas brtsams te phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pas sgo tshad tsam bris la thod pas bkab/ rdo rjes mnan la rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na kha phye ste ltas rtags ngan na khro bo'i sngags kyis bsrung bar bya/ dbus kyi phur khung lnga mas rim pas dgang / re'u mig dang lha snam phyogs mdog mdung rnams nag po la rdo rje ser pos mtshan pa/ dbus su ro mgo med lag med la rdo rje gri gug phyag mtshan so so'i gnas su phyag mtshan rnams rtse phyir bstan pa mgo mtshams brgyad du ro lang ngam gri gug brgyad bri/

mi nus na gtso 'khor thams cad la so so'i kha dog dang bstun pa'i tshom bu bkod/ gzhan rnams spyi dang mthun par bris la thig skud dkris pa dang tshon lhag gong bzhin bshams la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs phyag rgya bcas yid mchod lnga phul/ khur tshur rgyab sbyar bas mtheb srin gyis se gol dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥthig tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ spos sna rol mo dang bcas/ slob dpon gyis lag g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu rgyun chags kyis/ yig brgya bzla bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum gyi mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gnas bzhin pas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥsogs lan dgu brjod la dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'bul tshul byas mthar rang gi mgor btugs te/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas shar sgo'i phyi'i g.yas rang gi g.yon du bzhag la las bum thogs pas oṃ ya man+tā ka sogs bzlas bzhin pas skor ba gcig byas/ mthar shar du 'khod bzhin pas rang gi mgo bor gtugs la bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes shar sgo'i phyi'i g.yon rang gi g.yas su bzhag go /ras bris ltar na gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du bris sku rab gnas can dgram mo/ /dngos gzhi'i nyin phar dkyil 'khor pa/ /spyi dang so so'i mchod pa rnams/ /rdul tshon ltar na zlum po dang / /ras bris ltar na gru bzhir bshams/ /'das dang 'jig rten sngon 'gro dang / /phyi rol gtor ma lcog stegs sogs/ /bsham ste g.yas nas chu gnyis dang / /g.yon nas me tog spos me dri/ /zhal zas mdun nas rgyab bar dang / /gtor mdun ting 'bru chu bcas bshams/ /maṇ+ḍal dbu rgyan grogs yod na/ /so sor dung chos sogs bsham mo/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor 'dus te mchod pa byin rlabs kyi bar gong sta gon gyi skabs bzhin byas la/

mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad par zhes sogs kyis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas gnas gsum dang skye mched byin rlabs kyi bar thams cad gong sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin du byas la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ sogs nas/ bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gsor bas sta gon gyi lha'i phyir 'brang gis bgegs sprad la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod de dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la zhes sogs sta gon bzhin la rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ tshur byon tshur byon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi zad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra bhai ra wa sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod de/ dbang bskur dang rgyas btab sngon bzhin byas la rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog gtor te/ 'dir bzhugs 'dir bzhugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes sogs gong ltar las/ mthu rtsal drag po bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis dgug gzhug bya/ sems pa sum brtsegs bsgom/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pa'i bar sta gon bzhin/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ oṃ ya man+ta ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya man+ta ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bhā wa/ su to ṣa yo me bhā wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrā+e ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ya man+ta ka mā me muñdza/ ya man+ta ka ma hā sa mā ya/ ma man+ta ka āḥ lan gsum brjod de/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal tu gsol/

zhes brjod/ de nas mar me la sogs pa spar te sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mchod bstod rgyas par byas la/ sgrub khang gi phyi'am dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad pa'i phyir gong gi phyi rol gtor ma mchod chas slob dpon gyi mdun du bshams/ chus sbyangs gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin rlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo zhes sogs gtor bsngo bzhin la/ a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas bkug ste/ gtor snod kyi mthar/ shar du brgya byin dkar po mig stong dang ldan pa glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa be con/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum/ shar lhor me lha dmar po rwa skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhis g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ghun+de 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngo nag ro la zhon pa ral gri/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang khu sha wa la zhon pa ba dan/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa ghun+de/ 'og tu sa lha ser po phag pa la zhon pa bum pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la/ snying kha nas sprul pa'i phur bu btab par mos shing 'debs tshul byas te/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye ya ma ya/ nirt-i na ye/ wa ru ṇa ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ i shwa r+ya/ brah+ma ṇā ya/ pṛ thi we bh+yaḥbadz+ra ki li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyi bo nas phur bus btab pas skad gcig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur/ spro na gnas gsum mig sogs byin rlabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ thams cad la mi bskyod pas rgyas btabs/ dbang lha ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim pa rnams byas nas/

de la gtor bsngo bzhin gtor ma 'bul ba nas 'phrin las gzhol ba'i bar dang / dpal ldan bla ma sogs gtor bsngo bzhin/ mchod pa rnams mtha' nas 'dus te mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shūd dha sarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ shwa dha ya sarba bigh+nan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes kha bshal chu sbyin la/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ muḥ zhes pas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs par bsam/ rang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod pa/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin drag sngags rol mo dang bcas pas bskrad/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal/ nang du log ste dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du langs shing gnas pa'i rdo rje thugs kar dang dril bu rgyun chags kyis/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /mchog sbyin rdo rje khyod la 'dud/ /yang dag thal gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod༞ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rgyas pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /spos sna rdor dril rol chen bcas/ yig brgya brjod bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum bya ba'am byas par bsam la/ spos rdor dril rol mo bzhag mdun nas thal sbyar gyis/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang /

bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par bzhes nas lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes phyag bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid stan la 'dug ste/ bla ma dang gtso bo gnyis su med pas cho ga rnams mdzad las rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pas mdzad par bsam zhing dngos su rang gis byas la/ slob dpon gyis las bum dang gzhan rnams kyis rang rang gi dung chos su rnam rgyal bum chu bskyed pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis nas/ /sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba tā thā ga tā sogs brjod cing bum chu cung re 'thung la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje'i 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul la me tog dang bcas thal mo snying khar sbyar/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen pos tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig 'di ni bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du/

/mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs bcing ba'i tshul/ u dum wa ra man+da ra/ /yongs bsdu dang ni mā li ka /kar+ṇi ka yi phreng ba 'di/ /legs par nod de bus zungs shig /āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ me tog len tshul/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i tshogs spros te dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang las bum gyi chu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi lus la gtor nas bsrung bar byas par mos/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /lan phul bar bsam la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /de'i bu la ci zhig bya/ /lan phul bar bsam la/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /rang gi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud pā ta ya mi/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag ste brtan par bya/ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin/ /de yis sangs rgyas 'grub par gyur/ /gang zhig de nyid ma mthong bas/ /mdun du smra ba ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par gyur/ /de bas nan tan gnas par gyis/ /zhes gsang bar gdams/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pas sgo ba bzhis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du 'khrid par mos te mgo bo dud pa dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya/ sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sgo rnams dbye bar bsam pa ni phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang gi 'jug pa la shar sgo nas bla ma yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs las phyag byas par mos ste/ thal mo dpral bar sbyar te/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ de bzhin du mgrin par sbyar nas/

na ma mi hūm̐/ snying khar sbyar nas/ na mo na ma hūm̐ swāhā/ shar nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te byin gyis brlabs par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pus+d+yā nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma mo hān ta kṛta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ lho sgo nas zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar te/ dbang bskur bar gsol bas yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya at+ma naṃ nīr+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta at+ma pi shu nān+ta krita a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ nub sgo nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo mgrin par sbyar te/ chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta pū dzaḥpra wā ta nā ya at+ma naṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta at+ma rā gan tā kṛta dharmā tsakra pra warta na yā mi/ byang sgo nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar ste 'phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza karma ṇe at+ma naṃ nir+ya tā yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta at+ma ir+ṣ+yan ta kṛta karma ku ru maṃ/ de nas shar sgo nas gzhug ste 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying khar sbyar te slob dpon la dngos grub thams cad gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta swa bhā wa badz+ra ā tsār+ya pā da ni ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi sarba sid+dhi pra yats+tshan+tu maṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro sems bskyed pa dang rigs lnga'i dam tshig 'dzin pa ni me tog dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo sbyar la sgrub thabs bzhin/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs tshar gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs tshar gsum brjod/ de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung zhing zhes dam la bzhag pa bzhi las/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/

ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje gtugs la/ gshin rje gshed dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs par gyur/ /nga yi bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di/ /dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang / /gang yang gzhan la smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu gral te gshegs/ /yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gem par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu cung zad myangs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub thob/ /'thung shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /pañtsa u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /gshin rje gshed po nga yin gyis/ /nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /khyod kyis skye ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la brnyas pa min/ /de bzhin mos pa ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong bzhin tshom bu bdun ma bsdus pa 'di bzhin slob ma slob dpon gsang sher bzhi pa rnams zhu ba'i yon la'ang rigs 'dre/

me tog rdor thal bcas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu brdungs pa lta bu mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan dang bcas pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su dzh+raiṃ me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snying kha'i nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ mgrin pa chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po a yis mtshan pa/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang khu ha yis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi dzh+raiṃ me 'bar ba rkang pa'i nang nas gyen du song bas/ sum mdo'i raṃ dang 'dres shing 'bar bas lus thams cad gang sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying kha'i sa yang tshig mgrin pa'i chu yang bkol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang pa'i rlung gis bteg me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du rang gi lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ zhes dang rdor dril gsor dkrol rol chen bcas/ hrīḥṣ+ṭi'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a bhi sha ya hūm̐/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ/ zhes mang du brjod la rol mo bya/ de'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i ched du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag te/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab pa ni/ rdo rje gsor dril bu sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su dkrol la gdangs dang bcas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/

/gshin rje gshed dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin gshegs/ /rigs ni gang gis snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ me tog 'bul ba'i steng ga byas/ oṃ ma hā pū dza pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ spyi bor bzhag la/ pra ti gṛh+na satwaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la oṃ/ zhes brjod/ mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ dkar po bsgom la ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal bar mos/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyis/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs dkrol te/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ma hā maṇ+ḍa la pra we sha ya phaṭa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gang rtogs zhing khams rnam dag mchog /bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin/ /rdo rje'i thugs rje'i rgyun gnas pa'i/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi chad/ /bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthong / phun sum tshogs kun 'dis 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos grub bsgrub phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags don la brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod cing rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar mos la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong ba yin no/ /slob ma'i dbang zhu yon gong bzhin la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs me tog rdor thal bcas/ ji ltar rdo rje chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du rin po che'i khri chen po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang /

gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pas rang la mchod cing / bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtsos thugs ka nas 'phros pas rigs lngas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mo'i mchod pa phul bar gyur/ zhes dang las rdor gyis rnam bum bteg gzhan rnams kyis rdor dril mdangs bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ /ma lus sems can bskyed byed bde ba chen po yis/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /zhes pa tsam yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs par brjod/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi slad du ya man+ta dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhiḥlas ral gri dhiḥyis mtshan pa las 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ de'i rnam shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ nam mkhar zhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra u da ka zhes sogs nas/ a haṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ rdo rje thal sbyar gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te dbang bskur bar mos/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa thogs/ gzhan rnams kyis so so'i dung chos chu blug pa mgor bzhag ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas hi zhes gsungs shing ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nang dbang gi slad du rdor thal dang / dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer sngon po byung / rang gi lus la phog dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa 'od kyi lam nas gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu thig le'i rnam pas rang snang gi yum gyi khar bab pa zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing / dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs la gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung /

de nyid bha ga nas phyir thon te dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod/ so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chus dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag ces rtogs pa bskyed do/ /bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ rang nyid mi dmigs te nas na bza' can/ bar gong bzhin/ de'i tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i nas yar lud pa las bar 'dra/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ thugs ka'i sogs 'dra/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par sogs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu brgyan du gyur/ rdor thal de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ dbu brgyan gyon la/ sangs rgyas kun dngos cod paṇa dbang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir/ /cod paṇa mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ /oṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūm̐ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka nas ha haṃ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur sogs nas/ yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par sogs/ rdor thal/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs/ yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer ser po byung / rang gi sogs nas/ khar bab pas sogs/ ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po zhal gcig sogs 'dra/ rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug sogs/ ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par sogs/

nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes sngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag bsangs sbyangs/ rang nyid sogs nas/ na bza' can bar/ de'i 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / nam mkha' nas/ yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ thugs ka sogs 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par sogs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ rdor thal/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ rdo rje gsor mtha' thugs kar bzung la/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje mchog gis dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa yā mi/ badz+ra u da ka sogs nas/ a haṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sogs nas/ yar lud pa las nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par sogs/ rdor thal/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs/ gsung gi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer dmar po byung sogs/ khar bab pa 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig sogs/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i sogs/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar 'dra/ de lta na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag

bsangs sbyangs/ rang nyid sogs nas/ na bza' can bar/ de'i 'dus byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu da las ral gri das mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / nam mkhar nas/ yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ thugs ka'i sogs 'dra/ don yod grub pa'i rnam par sogs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ rdor thal/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ dril bu bsil/ chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrogs pa/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā shap+ta pa ta le dharmā dha tu a bhi ṣi ka ta shrī sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs nas/ a hi zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sogs nas/ yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ don yod grub pas rnam par sogs/ rdor thal/ dpal ldan 'phrin las rdo rje 'dzin sogs/ 'phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer ljang khu byung sogs/ khar babs pa phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu zhal gcig sogs 'dra/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug sogs/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar 'dra/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag bsangs sbyangs/ rang nyid sogs nas na bza' can bar/ de'i gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang /
