rdor thal/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ rdol dril bsnol ba spyi bor bzhag oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa satwoṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta shrī sa ma ya hūm̐/ dpal chen mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs dang / a hi zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sogs nas/ yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par sogs/ rdor thal/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs/ sku yi rdo rje bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab pas gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer dkar po byung sogs/ khar bab pa gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po zhal gcig sogs 'dra/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug sogs/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par sogs/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar 'dra/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rang gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / rdor thal/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs nas a haṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur sogs nas/ yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje gsor mthar thugs kar bzung la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/

/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hīḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ rang gi snying nang du rang 'dra'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ slob dpon gyi dbang zhu yon gong bzhin la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs rdor thal me tog bcas/ kye hoḥkhyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /nus phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang / /snying rje gter gyi bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum/ bsangs sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i drung du rin po che'i khri chen po pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ rang nyid sogs nas na bza' can bar/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po yab yum du bskyed/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rdor thal/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje gsum du bdag sgrub shig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas 'od zer sngon po byung sogs khar babs pa rdo rje sngon po yab yum mam/ rdo rje 'jigs byed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i gdong pa can gyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa gang rung du bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ka ya waka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje/ thugs ka nas sogs dbang nas/ dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par rigs 'gre/ thugs kyi dam tshig byin par bsam la rdo rje gsor mthar thugs kar bzung ba dang bcas/ 'di de sogs nas/ hi hūm̐ bar gong bzhin/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/

/kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyem ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes su la'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ rang gi sems rig stong gnyis su med pa'i nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos/ gsung gi dam tshig byin par bsam la/ dril gsil mthar dku g.yon par kha gyen bstan bzung ba dang bcas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bshad/ /a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam par byed par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+ḍe ā/ rang gi ngag grag stong gnyis su med pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjes byin gyis brlab/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas rjes su gnang ba mdor bsdus te byin nas sku'i dam tshig gi slad du rdo rje dril bu snying khar bsnol te yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul byas pas nu ma la sogs pa reg pas bde ba nyams su myong bar mos la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bzung / /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /cir 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags/ /yid kyi lus ni bstan phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te rang gi lus snang stong gnyis su med pa nges par don gyi lha sku yin no snyam du mos/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas a haṃ zhes gsungs shing ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sogs nas/

chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha thams cad ye shes pa'i tshul du thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes rang la me tog gtor/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs gong bzhin mchod la dbu rgyan bzhag dkyil 'khor lha'i rnam dag ni/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnams rnam par dag pa yin la/ dur khrod ni lus dang 'jig rten gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin cing / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor de kho na nyid dang / lha rnams sangs rgyas ye shes dang yon tan dang 'phrin las rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang / de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ba yin no/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa zhes sogs nas/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya ba lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang dang / gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du bzhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs dang oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs dang / oṃ ya man+ta ka sogs tshar gsum re me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal legs kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ me tog spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang dang / sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas ni/ /bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul na de/ /skad cig gi ni gzi can gyur/ /bud med rnams kyis yongs bskor la/ /kun nas brtse ba'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams༞ /skad cig gi༞ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams byas pa gang yin pa/

/sangs rgyas༞ /skad cig༞ /ces mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang / mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya/ /de phyir gshin rje 'joms pa yi/ /brtul zhugs rnam par kun tu spyod/ /phar cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni/ /brtul zhugs med pas mi 'grub pas/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs 'di/ /legs mchod mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs/ /zhes brtul zhugs kyi rje gnang dang / ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs pas/ sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin/ /byang chub spyod mchog gzhan dag dang / /'dul sogs dge ba de lta min/ /de bas dam tshig bus srung zhig /rtag tu sdom pa yongs zung ngo / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste/ /de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig bsrungs/ /dkon mchog gnod pa bsad bya zhing / /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /pha rol nor ni blangs bya zhing / /rtag tu brdzun gyi tshig kyang smos/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrungs/ /zhes dam tshig gi rjes gnang dang / rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo/ lag par dung dang dril bu/ lag ngar gyi steng du pusti byin par bsam la/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyi ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ 'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus par/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rin chen༞ /pad+ma'i༞ /sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang dang / sna tshogs rdo rje byin par bsam la/ zhi ba'i sems kyi zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyi rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab bskor byed/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyi ni/ /dbang gi las ni yang dag bsgrub/

/gsad pa'i sems kyi drag po ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /zhes 'phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang dang khaṃ las skyes pa'i ral gri byin par bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pus mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung / /oṃ badz+ra khaḍ+ga hūm̐/ zhes pas khyad par drag po'i rjes gnang / ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par bgyi/ /zhes dngos grub kyi rjes su gnang / lag g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gzan gyi sna lta bu seṅge'i sna ba ltar bzung la/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /gshin rje gshed dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du sarba bhūr bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa de la dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di yis mthu yin no/ /zhes lung bstan nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyi nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces pas dbugs dbyung nas/

gzengs bstod pa ni/ de ring khyod bdag legs par brnyed/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skye/ /sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas/ /gsang sngags nyams med sems las grub/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong ba'am yang na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /byang chub sems mchog rmad byung brnyed/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyis/ /skye rga na 'chis 'jig par byed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pas/ /phyag na rdo rje da gyur to/ /zhes gzengs bstod/ de lta na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul sku'i rten 'brel sngon du byas pa yin no/ /gsang dbang zhu yon gong bzhin la/ gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ rdor thal me tog bcas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching tshul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi rang la 'thor tshul dkyil 'khor gtso bo rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu ba gsang gnas nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems de rang gi lce thog tu bzhag dngos su bdud rtsi lce la bzhag ste/ btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus nas rab bsgrub byed/ /bu khyod de ltar shes gyis la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig /rang gi myang bas lus thams cad gang zhing ngag gi dri ma dag nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur pa bsgom la/ a hoḥsu khaṃ/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar sgrol tshul/ de ltar na khyod kyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor nas gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag rang byin rlabs bzhi bsgom pa la dbang / longs sku'i rten 'brel sngon du byas pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu yon ji lta ba bzhin la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs gong bzhin/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas/ shes rab ye shes stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras 'ching tshul dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi 'thor/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma zhig sprul te rang la byin par bsam la/ gzungs ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs/ /'khor lo rim pas sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /de nas dri ba byas par mos la/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /lan btab par mos la/ ci gsungs dam tshig bstan pa ni/ /lha mo bdag nyid spror gyur to/ /zhes lan btab lha mo de dges te skra grol zhing gos dang bral bas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas mnyes pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig de spong ba/ /de la cho ga'i dngos grub med/ /satwaṃ pad+ma bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing dpang du byon par bsam la/ de'i mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze'u 'bru la ā yis mtshan pa dang / yab kyi gsang gnas stong pa las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu dmigs la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis/ thog mar 'khyud pa dang brtsum pa la sogs pa'i tshe dga' ba'i ye shes/ byang chub kyi sems mkha' gsang gi rtse mor 'dzoms nas phyir ma 'phos pa gnas pa'i tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos/ slar yang gyen du drangs te lte ba dang / snying ga dang / spyi gtsug tu bsten pas mas bstan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong bar mos/ mig dar dgrol tshul gong bzhin/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel sngon du byas pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa zhu yon gong bzhin la/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs rdor thal me tog bcas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs gong bzhin la/ bzhi pa yang ni stsal du gsol/ /gsum/ mig dar bdud rtsi gong bzhin/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa/ /bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi bsgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid ma shes na/ de kho na nyid bsgom min te/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes na/ /de ni bsgom pa rab tu grags/ /rang nyid lha sku bde stong dbyer med bsgom/ bsgom bya bsgom byed dang bral ba'i ngang blo re shig bzhag mig ras 'grol tshul gong bzhin/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa la dbang / ngo bo nyid sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /rdor thal me tog gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/

/lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal mjug yon dbul ba'i skabs ltar byas la/ dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o sogs dang / deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /gsum/ rdo rje gsor dril bu bcad btub tu dkrol te/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' dag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags snyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces lan gcig dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzugs brnyan gyi tshul snang ba yang chos sku stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa las byung ba'i byin rlabs dang / slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis nam zhig slob ma rnams kyis kyang rdul tshon nam mtshan ma la sogs pa tsam ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa gzugs kyi skur mthong bar gyur cig snyam pas/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/

/khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba slob ma rnams/ /kun gyi dri med mthong bar shog /lan gsum 'phags pa rin po ches/ bden stobs brjod pa las de yang ma gsungs/ gtor bsngo 'jug chog sta gon bzhin la nongs bshags tshigs bcad tshig lhug gi mthar rdul dkyil zhag bsgrub ltar na rten bzhugs spyi 'dre'i mthar khyad par du yang zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du zhes sogs brjod la rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba dang / dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya'o/ /rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi tshe/ bum pa gnyis khyams kyi steng du bzhag la cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas/ sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la rten bzhugs byas la/ rten la ma brtan pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes rnams dang / rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ ad+ya nut+pan na twata/ ces dang / oṃ khyed kyi sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol byas te/ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas lha'i mtshan ma nas rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis blangs la spyi bor bzhag

rdo rje rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang po gshegs/ de nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la sbyin/ gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim pas bsdus te za ma tog la sogs par blug la rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga'am/ de tsam ma nus na bkur bsti chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam/ khron pa la sogs par gshegs su gsol/ thig rjes rnams dri zhim pos chus mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te/ rjes mi mngon par byas la gnas gsum dang skye mched bsrung zhing / dge ba bsngo ba rnams sta gon bzhin/ ras bris ltar na zhag bsgrub grol nyin bum pa gong bzhin bkod/ dkyil 'khor la rten bzhugs/ bum pa'i ye shes pa rten med pa gshegs gsol byas la/ de man gong bzhin no/ /de nas zhwa gyon rdor dril bsil bcas pas me tog 'thor zhing / dril bu sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su bsil la gdangs dang bcas pas/ dpal mchog byin rlabs sprin sngon rol pa las/ /dpal ldan dus dgra'i smin grol zim char rgyun/ /dpal 'byor snod ldan zhing sar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /dpal 'bar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje'i dbyings las gdug can rjes bzung phyir/ /rdo rje'i rol pa khro chen ma he'i zhal/ /rdo rje'i 'khor tshogs gtum rngams ro langs brgyad/ /rdo rje'i lha tshogs drag shugs bkra shis shog /'jigs rung dur khrod yongs bskor gang de'i phyir/ /'jigs shing sra brtan srung 'khor byin za 'bar/ /'jigs pa'i khro chen gzhal yas de dbus gnas/ /'jigs pa'i rnam 'phrul mi zad bkra shis shog /mdzad phrin mkha' khyab srid pa myang 'das phyir/ /mdzad tshul 'phrin las bzhi yi bka' nyan pa/ /mdzad pas phyogs skyong dkar nag las kyis gnyer/ /mdzad la thogs med dam can bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i nying khus skal bzang smin cing grol/ /bstan pa spel ba'i lhag bsam nus mthur ldan/

/bstan pas khyab pa'i snod bcud dge legs sbyor/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs rgya cher brjod la me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgras 'gengs shing dga' ston la rol lo/ /'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor sgrub dkyil bcas/ /rwa chen 'gro mgon 'phags chen dgongs pa bzhin/ /dkon mchog ni rā bho ga'i snang gnyis dang / /rol dgongs sa skya kun blos bsgrigs 'di la/ /nyes mchis bshags shing dge bas smin grol bka'/ /yun dar 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rab 'joms phyir/ /dang po'i blo can rab gsal 'dir gyur cig/ //shū bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 58 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi sgrub dkyil/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 59
